title: Natural Q&A #10
summary: A non-training Q&A in which NH explains why he stopped posting training footage, and covers social media and screens for kids, homeschooling, his boxing and swimming past, euthanasia, which manga he plans to cover, meeting women, how to read philosophy, gender identity, modern art, learning Japanese, school motivation and sitting posture.
claims: NH stopped uploading training clips for months because YouTube Shorts flood recommendations with low-effort content, and short lift clips draw subscribers who do not fit the channel's long-form content

Big channels promised for two years to run online natural bodybuilding competitions for the community but never did because there was no money in it; he held back training-footage formats for that occasion
Training videos should be the spark that gets you training, not a substitute; many viewers live vicariously through other people's workouts
He sets all his videos as not made for kids so they are not recommended to children, because young viewers cannot judge which content harms them
Social media is a tool of social engineering and mostly poison for young people; TikTok promotes self-improvement content in China but brain-rotting trends in the West
His future children will have no screens until about 7 or 8, and will get books, chess, outdoor play, sports and socialising instead

He would homeschool his children until about 6 or 7 and then possibly send them to school for half days, watching closely for social development; he found elementary and middle school mostly a waste of time
NH turned down a Discord server because YouTuber-centred Discords become parasocial worship; community-run attempts failed without him, and he wants the comment community to stand on its own
Erwin Smith is his favourite Attack on Titan character because he is balanced and finally chooses his country over his own selfish quest for the truth
NH calls himself a naturally gifted swimmer: as a toddler who nearly drowned he already knew how to swim
He started boxing at 16, was moved up to the adult class because the kids would not spar him, and was known for a hard punch, partly from rage built up during two years of bullying
Everyone should spar with a professional boxer once to learn how little they actually know
He stopped boxing for basketball after an eye exam found that his nearsightedness put him at high risk of retinal detachment; his coach had wanted him to go pro and he regrets stopping
Judge historical religious texts by the norms of their time; homophobia in them came from survival-focused societies where reproduction was central
He believes sexual orientation is biological, citing a study from about seven years earlier linking a testosterone peak during pregnancy to whether the brain is tuned to male or female pheromones

NH wants to be euthanised if he spends more than two weeks in a coma and has agreed this with his family, but the decision should rest with the individual, made while sound of mind, never with the state or caregivers
Baki copyright holders had struck about 15 of his Baki videos, roughly a dozen strikes, and he can restore only one a month; he avoids Dragon Ball Z for the same reason
He had all the source material for at least 40 Berserk videos on the Black Swordsman and Golden Age arcs, planned Hajime no Ippo videos for that summer, and listed more series to cover
Approach women often and respectfully in public; take rejection gracefully and read the situation
School and college offer the most chances to meet women but come with hookup culture; meeting through mutual friends works because you arrive already vouched for
Being social and getting out into the community is essential for finding a partner; dating a coworker is risky because HR tends to side with the woman
To understand philosophy, read the book once for the style and big ideas, reread chapter by chapter with a pen underlining key concepts, then write a summary; if you can teach it, you understand it

He believes gender identity has a biological basis in rare cases but thinks many people transition because of trends or because they cannot cope with male responsibilities, and he links it to mental illness
He advises against pushing a relative who has transitioned with tough love, because pressure tends to drive them further into the community that persuaded them
He loves Impressionist and Romantic art and despises brutalism and most contemporary art, which he calls a money-laundering vehicle
Art, like a physique, should be beautiful; accepting ugliness in art leads to accepting it in bodies, as in the fat acceptance movement
He has no interest in learning Japanese or living in Japan; he would rather learn Spanish and Portuguese and improve his English
If you cannot get motivated for a school subject, change how you study it or teach yourself; he hated English class but loved it once he studied on his own
For sitting posture, imagine a string pulling the top of your head up: chest up, shoulders back and down, neck stacked; a pillow against the lower back and a screen at eye level help
Bad posture does exist: holding a rounded position for hours is harmful, so change position often while staying close to neutral
